name: Golf instructor

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)
A.staff: Kenji and Dana (pros at the academy)

services.name: golf lesson (5-lesson pack)
services.story: The main story: Alex buys a 5-lesson pack, $275 ($55 a lesson), and the first 60-minute lesson with Kenji uses one. A no-show can use one up, if Sam confirms.

services.name: golf lesson
services.story: A single 30-minute lesson, $35. A card is saved for the academy's $20 fee, and Alex pays at the front desk.

services.name: video swing review
services.story: A video swing review, $35. A card is saved, and charged when Kenji texts DONE after the reply call.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: 60-minute lesson at home
services.story: The main story: a $179 60-minute lesson at Alex's home with Tomas. A card is saved and charged $179 when Tomas texts DONE.

services.name: Lesson at home (3-lesson pack)
services.story: A 3-lesson pack at home, $450 ($150 a lesson), paid in full when booking. Each lesson uses one, and a no-show can use one up, if Sam confirms.

services_shape: one person's time: a lesson with a named pro, booked by the pro's free hours, at the academy, at the client's home net, or on a course the business lists; a partner lesson adds a second person
questions_before_times: new or returning (a new student gets the free swing check first, and the waiver)
what to work on: full swing, short game, putting, or a round on a course
where: the academy, at home, or on a course
a single lesson, a pack or a weekly plan
one person or two (a partner lesson)
safety_stop: someone unwell right now: chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting, or sudden weakness
someone hit in the head by a ball or a club, and now confused, bleeding badly or not waking up
lightning or a storm right now at the course or the range
license: none checked by Rosie: golf lessons need no state license here; a license or insurance is optional and the business's own word (D96)
staff_skills: full swing, short game, putting, juniors, and course play; juniors only with pros the owner clears for them
messages_never: health answers, injuries, a doctor's note and incident notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the student's record
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
